description: Curated single-edit fault inventory, not a cargo-mutants score. Each non-control cargo entry runs only its named primary Rust oracle with `--exact --test-threads 1`; cargo cofailure declarations are invalid. `runner: pytest` entries mutate the Python tooling and require their declared exact file-scope failure set. Each entry is paired with the message its primary test must emit. A mutation that its oracle does not reject is a proof gap, not a passing build. `profile: release` entries need the engine's debug invariants out of the way so the named test is what observes the defect.
